description: Search Agent Tested's hands-on test results for small AI tools, browser and editor extensions, CLIs and MCP servers. Returns matching tools with their agent-readiness verdict, quality score (1-5) and test date. Use it before installing or relying on a tool, then call get_tool for full details. Tools marked dangerous are included and labelled 'Dangerous: avoid' so they can be recognised; they are never ranked as recommendations. Untested tools have no score.

category.description: Tool kind (normalised from the dataset's free-text category).

include_dangerous.description: false hides tools marked Dangerous: avoid

no_signup.description: true = only tools that need no signup

query.description: Words to match against tool name, slug, summary and category. Empty or omitted lists all tools.

name: search_tools
title: Search Agent Tested tools
